description.text:
我們正在尋找一位具備 Linux BSP 與 Kernel Driver 開發經驗的工程師，負責關鍵系統軟體的開發、維護與移植工作。您將參與從需求分析、系統設計、實作到測試的完整流程，並投入產品在新平台上的整合與優化。
我們希望您具備：
- 五年以上 Linux 系統軟體開發經驗
- 精通 C，熟悉 Bash/Python
- 熟悉 Linux networking（如 netfilter、conntrack、iptables、tc、netlink）
- 有虛擬化網路（如 OpenVSwitch）與系統效能調校實務經驗
- 具備自動化工具開發、分散式系統經驗尤佳
目前專案正處於系統整合與驗證階段，新成員將深入參與測試與問題排查，快速掌握整體架構並展現技術影響力。我們期待一位主動積極、熱愛技術的夥伴加入，與我們一同打造穩定、高效的產品。
Responsibilities:
- Develop platform BSP and driver software based on Linux. ​
- Migrate existing software to new hardware platform.​
- In charge of the key development of networking features and system middleware. ​
- Participate in the full lifecycle of software development process, including requirement review, technical research, design, implementation, testing and documentation. ​
- Deliver reliable and scalable product solutions and take ownership for issue resolving. ​
- Work independently, proactively and collaboratively with a team.
Prerequisites:
- Minimum 5 years of work experience and solid in C programming.​
- Experience in Bash/Python programming.​
- Familiar with Unix/Linux environments.​
- Understanding of bridging, routing, and network protocols (e.g. TCP/IP, NAT, DHCP, DNS).​
- Knowledge of Linux kernel networking stack (e.g. packet flow, netfilter, conntrack, traffic control) and user space lib/tool (e.g. netlink, iptables, tc).​
- Experience with virtualized networking (e.g. OpenVSwitch).​
- Experience in Linux network device data path performance tuning.​
- Experience in software development with large scale distributed system.​
- Self-managed, self-motivated and self-learning.​
- Excellent at cross-functional-team collaboration.​
- Good analytical and problem-solving skills.
